description: Runtime configuration edited via the Settings UI. Secrets are included in GET responses.

agent.description: Defaults for the main agent loop (model id and safety caps).

llm_first_token_timeout_ms.description: How long a streamed LLM call may stay silent before the turn cancels it (an explicit 0 disables the guard).
llm_first_token_timeout_ms.title: LLM first token timeout ms

llm_min_interval_ms.description: Minimum gap between consecutive LLM calls in milliseconds, retries included (0 disables pacing).
llm_min_interval_ms.title: LLM min interval ms

llm_retry_base_ms.description: Initial backoff between LLM retries in milliseconds; a server-provided pause (Retry-After) overrides it.
llm_retry_base_ms.title: LLM retry base ms

llm_retry_max.description: Retries after retryable LLM errors such as HTTP 429 before failing the turn (an explicit 0 disables retries).
llm_retry_max.title: LLM retry max

loop_guard.description: Stop a response that degenerates into repeating itself, and block a tool called over and over with identical arguments.
loop_guard.title: Loop guard

loop_nudge_max.description: How many times one turn may be nudged back on track before the loop guard stops it.
loop_nudge_max.title: Loop nudge max

loop_stream_repeat_cycles.description: Identical back-to-back output cycles inside one streamed response before it is cut (0 disables the check).
loop_stream_repeat_cycles.title: Loop stream repeat cycles

loop_tool_repeat_limit.description: Consecutive identical tool calls before the loop guard steps in (0 disables the check).
loop_tool_repeat_limit.title: Loop tool repeat limit

max_tokens_per_turn.description: Upper bound on total tokens (prompt + completion) the model may use in one agent step.
max_tokens_per_turn.title: Max tokens per turn

max_turns.description: Hard cap on ReAct iterations (LLM calls plus tool rounds) for one user request.
max_turns.title: Max turns

providers.description: API credentials and transport selection for upstream LLM vendors.

api_base.description: Optional override of the default API base URL for this provider. Ignored for neuraldeep and codex, which use fixed official endpoints.
api_base.title: API base URL

api_key.description: You may set a literal key, reference ${ENV} in YAML (expanded when the file is loaded), or leave empty so the process reads the conventional NAME_API_KEY variable derived from the provider name (see provider name description).
api_key.title: API key

api_key_command.description: Optional credential-helper command. When api_key is empty it is run via the detected host shell (pwsh, powershell, or cmd on Windows; bash or sh elsewhere) and its trimmed stdout is used as the key (like git/docker credential helpers or AWS credential_process), letting the provider fetch short-lived or login-issued keys without storing a static secret. On failure resolution falls back to the conventional NAME_API_KEY variable.
api_key_command.title: API key command

name.description: Logical id used in model ids (provider/model-id). ASCII letters, digits, hyphen, and underscore only; must start with a letter. When api_key is empty, the runtime reads the key from the environment variable NAME_API_KEY (NAME is this field in uppercase with hyphens mapped to underscores).
name.title: Provider name

proxy.description: Optional per-provider outbound proxy. Use http:// or https:// for an HTTP proxy, or socks5:// / socks5h:// for SOCKS5 (socks5h resolves hostnames via the proxy). It overrides any proxy inherited from the environment or the editor. NO_PROXY is still honored and local addresses always connect directly. Leave empty to use the environment/editor proxy (HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY), or connect directly when there is none.
proxy.title: HTTP or SOCKS proxy

timeout_ms.description: Optional bound on each LLM HTTP request to this provider, including the streamed body read. 0 (the default) sets no client timeout.
timeout_ms.title: Request timeout ms
